welcome.label: Welcome to Lac Hôtel
welcome.title: An exceptional eco-lodge facing Lake Sahambavy
welcome.subtitle: The Natural Choice — Sahambavy · Fianarantsoa · Madagascar
welcome.p1: An essential stop on your journey, halfway between the North and South of Madagascar, Lac Hôtel is beautifully situated on the shores of Lake Sahambavy, nestled at the foot of the hill where the island's only tea plantation (520 hectares) stretches as far as the eye can see.
welcome.p2: Lac Hôtel offers the comfort of rooms in charming, typical bungalows — some on stilts — scattered throughout a lush tropical garden. You will be charmed by its gardens, tranquility, and attentive staff.

philosophy.title: The Natural Choice

hotel.heroSubtitle: A sanctuary in the heart of tea plantations
hotel.historyTitle: A dream born by the lake
hotel.historyP1: It was on the shores of Lake Sahambavy, in the Highlands of Madagascar, that Kim and Olga Leong laid the first stones of a dream: to create an exceptional place where nature and hospitality are one.
hotel.historyP2: Today, their daughter Maggie and her husband Sergi Formentin carry on this vision with passion. They have modernized the hotel while preserving its soul — that of an authentic refuge, rooted in Betsileo culture and committed to responsible tourism.
hotel.philosophyP1: Our philosophy is to promote rural economic development through local labor and agriculture. All our products — ice cream, cheese, bread, vegetables, yogurt — are homemade and grown on-site.
hotel.philosophyP2: In a 2-hectare garden, we organically grow most of what you will taste at our table. Salads are washed with permanganate, bread is kneaded every morning, and our green tea sorbet has become a signature.
hotel.ecoP1: Lac Hôtel is committed to preserving the primary forest in the Ranomafana–Andringintra corridor. We participate in reforestation, local economic development and the protection of endemic biodiversity.

theicole.historyTitle: 520 hectares of tea, a unique story

historyTimeline.text: Arrival of the French Institute of Coffee and Cocoa — beginning of scientific research on tea varieties cultivable in Madagascar.
The European Development Fund finances the plantation's expansion.
The company becomes a state enterprise (socialist period) under the name SOTEMAD.
Return to the private sector — Mauritian investors acquire 2/3 of the capital. Current name: SIDEXAM Sahambavy.
520 hectares — Madagascar's only tea plantation. Green tea development and organic tea project.

excursionSteps: Factory tour: discover the tea production stages
Walk through the vast plantation, meet the tea pickers

train.introP1: The FCE train (Fianarantsoa–East Coast) is the last passenger train still in service in Madagascar. This mythical line connects Fianarantsoa to Manakara, crossing 162 km of tropical forests, vertiginous cliffs and remote villages accessible only by rail.
train.introP2: Lac Hôtel Sahambavy is located just 2 minutes walk from Sahambavy station — the ideal starting point for this unique railway adventure.
